entities.name: Revolution on Mercadia
entities.description: An uprising on Mercadia in 4205 AR after the Weatherlight crash-landed there following the assault on Rath.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: An unfamiliar world where the Weatherlight crash-landed, ruled by Mercadians in an inverted mountain city.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship that escaped Rath and crash-landed on Mercadia.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane the Weatherlight escaped from.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A legendary dragon engine reprogrammed by Urza who transported the ancestors of the Cho-Arrim, Saprazzans and Rishadans to Mercadia; mistaken for the crew as a deity.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A reclusive forest-dwelling people who seized the Weatherlight and later joined the revolution.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member seized by the Cho-Arrim who allied with Cho-Manno.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Leader of the Weatherlight crew who trains Mercadian forces and becomes a leader and savior.

entities.name: Chief Magistrate of Mercadia
entities.description: Ruler of Mercadia, who is killed by the end of the revolution.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: Leader of the Cho-Arrim who survived the attack on Rushwood.

entities.name: Cateran
entities.description: Mercenaries hired by the Mercadians who slaughtered the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member held captive on Mercadia.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member held captive on Mercadia.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member forced to retrieve the Power Matrix.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member forced to retrieve the Power Matrix.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin threatened with execution by Volrath to force the Weatherlight's repair.

entities.name: Power Matrix
entities.description: A fabled artifact held at Saprazzo, later installed on the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Saprazzo
entities.description: An island city whose telepathic Saprazzans guarded the Power Matrix.

entities.name: Saprazzans
entities.description: Telepathic people of Saprazzo who saw through the Mercadian deception and joined the revolution.

entities.name: Lahaime
entities.description: Leader of the Ramosian rebels.

entities.name: Ramosian rebels
entities.description: Rebels led by Lahaime who joined the revolution.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: Companion from Rath who was actually Volrath in disguise.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Shapeshifting Phyrexian ruler who disguised himself as Takara and ruled Mercadia from the shadows.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Takara's father, executed by Volrath.

entities.name: Henge of Ramos
entities.description: Site where Ramos was confronted and the five powerstones obtained.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Reprogrammed the dragon engine Ramos.

entities.name: Atalla
entities.description: A farm boy who spurred on the revolutionary forces.

entities.name: Subterranean Hangar
entities.description: A hangar under Mercadia City holding the Phyrexian fleet.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: The inverted mountain city of Mercadia.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Weatherlight returns to.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Leader of the Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The coming invasion of Dominaria.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia; the Cho-Arrim seize the ship and Orim, and Mercadians capture the rest of the crew.
events.quote: The Cho-Arrim , a reclusive forest-dwelling people, seized the ship along with Orim

events.summary: Gerrard negotiates with the Chief Magistrate to train the city's forces in exchange for help reclaiming the Weatherlight; Orim allies with Cho-Manno; the Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim.
events.quote: Gerrard agreed to train the city’s forces

events.summary: The Mercadians and Caterans betray the crew, capturing the Weatherlight and imprisoning them.
events.quote: the Mercadians and Caterans betrayed them, capturing the Weatherlight and imprisoning the crew once more

events.summary: With hostages held, the Mercadians force Hanna, Sisay and Orim to retrieve the Power Matrix from Saprazzo, then steal it and murder its guardians.
events.quote: the Mercadians betrayed them again, stealing the artifact and murdering its guardians while attempting to frame Orim

events.summary: The Saprazzans, Cho-Arrim and Ramosians unite with the Weatherlight crew to overthrow the Mercadian regime.
events.quote: With their forces united, the Saprazzans, the Cho-Arrim, and the Ramosians joined the Weatherlight crew to overthrow the Mercadian regime.

events.summary: Gerrard and allies realize Takara is Volrath in disguise, who executed Starke il-Vec.
events.quote: Takara , their companion from Rath, was none other than Volrath in disguise.

events.summary: Crew members go to the Henge of Ramos; Gerrard sways Ramos, who gives up five powerstones, which Volrath steals.
events.quote: Volrath — still masquerading as Takara — stole them and returned to Mercadia City.

events.summary: Under Volrath's control, Hanna, Karn and Squee are forced to repair the Weatherlight; the revolutionary forces attack.
events.quote: forced to repair the Weatherlight under the threat of Squee’s execution

events.summary: Rebels storm the Subterranean Hangar and destroy the Phyrexian fleet; the Weatherlight is reclaimed.
events.quote: they destroyed the Phyrexian fleet assembled in preparation for the coming invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: The crew shoots down Volrath's flagship, but he escapes through a planar portal.
events.quote: the crew shot down Volrath’s vessel, though the shapeshifter himself managed to escape via a planar portal

events.summary: With the Chief Magistrate dead and the Kyren rulers exiled, the peoples form a united government.
events.quote: With the Chief Magistrate dead and the Kyren rulers exiled

events.summary: The upgraded Weatherlight leaves Mercadia and Gerrard leads the crew back to Dominaria.
events.quote: Gerrard, having embraced his role as a leader and savior, led his crew back to Dominaria

relations.note: Transported the ancestors of the peoples to Mercadia.
relations.quote: Ramos had transported the ancestors of the Cho-Arrim, Saprazzans, and Rishadans to Mercadia
Cho-Manno , the leader of the Cho-Arrim
Lahaime , leader of the Ramosian rebels
Volrath executed Takara's father Starke il-Vec in vengeance for his past betrayals.

relations.note: Final confrontation between the Weatherlight crew and Volrath.
relations.quote: the final battle against Volrath’s flagship ensued
A legendary dragon engine reprogrammed by Urza
